releaseNotes: Redesigned guided tutorial now opens My Week, All Recipes, My Recipes, Shopping List and Settings in turn.
Explains seven useful features without overwhelming new users.
Bottom navigation keeps its usual white background and highlights the active tab.
Tap outside an explanation to move to the next step, without activating underlying controls.
Includes Skip, Finish and replay from Settings; existing saved meals, favourites, inventory and shopping checkmarks stay intact.
